endorsements.description: Corentin BAYET (@OnlyTheDuck) of @Reverse_Tactics used three bugs to go from the QNAP QHora-322 to the QNAP TS-464, but 1 had been previously seen in the contest. He still earns $41,750 and 8.5 Master of Pwn points.

endorsements.name: Corentin Bayet
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Vancouver 2024 - Day One Results
endorsements.description: Bruno PUJOS and Corentin BAYET from REverse Tactics ( @Reverse_Tactics ) combined two Oracle VirtualBox bugs - including a buffer overflow - along with a Windows UAF to escape the guest OS and execute code as SYSTEM on the host OS. This fantastic research earns them $90,000 and 9 Master of Pwn points.
